title: Rust: Async Streams
description: Work with async streams that yield values over time.

steps.title: Stream Trait Basics
steps.description: Create a simple countdown stream that yields values 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. Implement using a manual approach with a channel or iterator.

steps.title: Stream Transformation
steps.description: Take a stream of numbers, use `.map()` to double each, `.filter()` for >5, and collect. Print the result.

steps.title: Custom Stream Implementation
steps.description: Implement a `Stream` that yields random numbers by implementing `next()`. Generate 5 random numbers and print them.
hints: Use a custom struct that implements `next()`.
Track state: count of remaining values.
Yield values one at a time.

verification.failureMessage: Create and consume a custom stream.

steps.title: Merging Streams
steps.description: Create two streams and merge them using `select!`. Stream A yields letters "A", "B", "C" and Stream B yields numbers 1, 2, 3. Interleave the output.
hints: Two separate streams that yield at different simulated intervals.
Use a channel approach to send values to a combined receiver.
Print each value as it arrives from either stream.

verification.failureMessage: Merge and print values from both streams.

steps.title: Stream Error Handling
steps.description: Create a stream that can produce errors. Use `Result` items. Handle errors by either skipping them or collecting both Ok and Err values separately.
hints: Collect both: partition `.collect::<Vec<_>>()` into success and error.

verification.failureMessage: Process a stream with both success and error values.
